g.text: HR 1280x768 FP16 / CUDA Graph / RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU / Nsight Systems CUDA node trace
Time is relative to the first displayed frame enqueue. One CPU owner submits the session.
Pale bars = stage envelopes. Dark bars = actual kernel / copy activity. Small control kernels are gray.
Hardware JPEG decoder activity is not exposed here. D, M and nvJPEG conversion share the same GPU SM resources.
Profiled timings include tracing overhead. Activity overlap is not GPU utilization or an isolated kernel cost.
